name: Top-down adventure
description: Explore rooms seen from above: talk to a villager, find a key, open a locked door, dodge a slime and escape.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move, E or Space to talk, R to restart
features: Three connected rooms with walls and doors
A villager and a sign to talk to
A key that opens a locked door
A wandering slime and three hearts
Win and game-over screens with restart
